title: Penthouse Magazine February 1991 Complete w/ Centerfold Marion Barry Jane Fonda
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine intact. Light edge wear. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, February 1991 issue, original $4.95 cover price. Complete with centerfold. (The year on the cover is hidden behind the model's hand; this is the February 1991 issue.)

Cover features: the Marion Barry videotape story; Dog Mafia: selling pets for research; Jane Fonda's new battles with Vietnam vets; Heir Power: Steve Forbes takes over; Judicial Outrage.

Back cover: Malibu cigarettes ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
